titleEn: Booking a clinic appointment by phone
canDoYue: 你識打電話約第一個診症時間、講症狀、揀醫生、帶身份同保險卡、問費用，同埋早十分鐘到。
canDoEn: Book the first clinic appointment by phone, name a symptom, choose the doctor, bring identity and an insurance card, ask the fee, and arrive ten minutes early.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Hello there. Can I book the first clinic appointment, and may I name my symptom?
dialogue.glossYue: 你好。我可唔可以約第一個診症時間，同埋講我嘅症狀？
dialogue.say: Hello there. Can I book the first clinic appointment, and may I name my symptom?

dialogue.speaker: wen
dialogue.text: Yes. The first free appointment is tomorrow morning. Which doctor would you like to see?
dialogue.glossYue: 可以。最早嘅預約係聽朝。你想見邊位醫生？
dialogue.say: Yes. The first free appointment is tomorrow morning. Which doctor would you like to see?

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Doctor Wen, please. What is the fee, and should I bring my identity card too?
dialogue.glossYue: 請搵 Wen 醫生。費用幾多，我使唔使帶身份證件？
dialogue.say: Doctor Wen, please. What is the fee, and should I bring my identity card too?

dialogue.speaker: wen
dialogue.text: The visit fee is two hundred dollars. Please bring your identity and the insurance card.
dialogue.glossYue: 診症費用二百蚊。請帶身份同保險卡。
dialogue.say: The visit fee is two hundred dollars. Please bring your identity and the insurance card.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Thanks. Should I arrive ten minutes early with my identity card for the first appointment?
dialogue.glossYue: 多謝。第一個預約，我係咪帶身份證件早十分鐘到？
dialogue.say: Thanks. Should I arrive ten minutes early with my identity card for the first appointment?

dialogue.speaker: wen
dialogue.text: Yes, please arrive ten minutes early and bring that identity card to the front desk.
dialogue.glossYue: 係，請早十分鐘到，帶身份證件去前台。
dialogue.say: Yes, please arrive ten minutes early and bring that identity card to the front desk.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Can I describe my main symptom very briefly when I arrive at the clinic desk?
dialogue.glossYue: 我到診所前台，可唔可以簡單講主要症狀？
dialogue.say: Can I describe my main symptom very briefly when I arrive at the clinic desk?

dialogue.speaker: wen
dialogue.text: Yes. Tell the doctor your symptom at the desk, and the fee stays the same.
dialogue.glossYue: 可以。喺前台同醫生講症狀，費用不變。
dialogue.say: Yes. Tell the doctor your symptom at the desk, and the fee stays the same.
